verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs describe in-product AI insights from user data. AI Chat answers questions across meetings and connected apps, summaries extract decisions, action items and insights, real-time coaching prompts draw on conversation history, and sentiment, keyword, blocker and objection monitoring is available. One community report called an auto-generated outline 'absurd, inaccurate', which questions output quality but does not contradict that the capability exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight and suggestion quality (all supporting evidence is vendor-claimed).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions and help you create follow-ups, reports, and content.
Otter turns every meeting into a clear summary with decisions, action items, and insights.
Get real-time, personalized coaching and prompts during calls based on your entire conversation history, company playbooks, and what's being discussed.
Otter's fully customizable, AI-powered meeting summaries automatically extract actionable insights based on meeting purpose and for different functional roles
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
